# app-client Project Rules

## Tech Stack

- **Next.js 15+** + **React 19** + **TypeScript 5.8+**
- **Repository**: `gook41/app-client`
- **Workspace**: `c:\WorkSpace\gook41.org\app-client`

## Directory Structure

```
app-client/
├── .github/chatmodes/      # AI 규칙 (-, instruction.md)
├── .vscode/               # VS Code 설정
├── src/pages/             # Next.js 페이지 + API
└── package.json           # deps & scripts
```

## Scripts

```bash
npm run dev    # 개발 서버
npm run build  # 빌드
```

## Code Patterns

### 컴포넌트

```typescript
// src/components/ui/Button.tsx
interface ButtonProps {
  children: React.ReactNode;
  variant?: "primary" | "secondary";
  onClick?: () => void;
}

export const Button: React.FC<ButtonProps> = ({
  children,
  variant = "primary",
  onClick,
}) => (
  <button className={`btn btn-${variant}`} onClick={onClick}>
    {children}
  </button>
);
```

### API 응답

```typescript
// src/types/ApiResponseType.ts
export interface ApiResponse<T = any> {
  success: boolean;
  data?: T;
  error?: string;
}
```

### 커스텀 훅

```typescript
// src/hooks/useUserData.ts
export const useUserData = (userId?: string) => {
  const [user, setUser] = useState<User | null>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  // 페칭 로직...

  return { user, loading, error };
};
```

## File Naming

- **컴포넌트**: `UserProfile.tsx`
- **페이지**: `index.tsx`, `about.tsx`
- **API**: `users.ts`, `[id].ts`
- **훅**: `useUserData.ts`
- **타입**: `UserType.ts`

## Import Order

```typescript
import React from "react"; // 1. React/Next
import axios from "axios"; // 2. 외부 라이브러리
import { Button } from "@/components"; // 3. 내부 모듈
import type { User } from "@/types"; // 4. 타입
```

## Git Convention

```
feat: 새 기능
fix: 버그 수정
docs: 문서 변경
refactor: 리팩토링
```

## Key Files

- `src/pages/_app.tsx` - 앱 진입점
- `src/pages/api/hello.ts` - API 예시
- `package.json` - 의존성
- `tsconfig.json` - TS 설정

간결하고 실용적인 Next.js 앱이 목표! 🚀
